title: Alternating ideal products realized by a chosen Koszul family before conormal descent
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal, n a natural number and P a projective resolution of A/I. There exist an augmentation-preserving family b(r,g) of maps from finite Koszul complexes to P and an A-multilinear alternating n-argument map F on I, with values in the I-annihilated submodule of H_n(P tensor A/I), such that for every actual Koszul wedge-cycle s of [new-e1-koszul-conormal-cycle-presentation], F applied to the ideal linear combinations of its vectors equals its image in homology under b(s.r,s.g). This only constructs ideal products for one family; it asserts neither descent to I/I squared nor relation vanishing for arbitrary specified families.

source.place: Lemma 23.6.12, Tate-resolution Tor products; Tag 00LS, Lemma 10.71.4(1), comparison with P

proof.text: Choose augmentation-preserving Koszul maps b(r,g) into P using new-e1-koszul-augmentation-lift-exists. After tensoring with A/I all Koszul differentials vanish: apply boundary_wedge from the generator-chain-map module and move each ideal coefficient to the quotient tensor factor. The inverse of iCyclesIso therefore gives a concrete A-linear cycle lift x ↦ x tensor 1, and composition with homologyπ and the homology map of b gives wedgeEval(r,g).

For a rectangular substitution t between free modules satisfying linearCombination(g) composed with t = linearCombination(f), assemble exteriorPower.map q t into a chain map U in every degree. The boundary_wedge formula verifies the chain equations, and zeroEquiv_naturality verifies the augmentation. By new-r4-koszul-augmentation-lift-homotopy, b(f) and U followed by b(g) are homotopic. Tensor this homotopy, use homologyπ_naturality and cyclesMap_i, and identify the explicit cycle lifts by monicity of iCycles. This proves wedgeEval(f,x) = wedgeEval(g, exteriorPower.map n t x).

Define ev(w) using the basis wedge in the Koszul complex on w:Fin n→I. Apply substitution invariance with t=linearCombination(v) to express ev(linearCombination(g) composed with v) as wedgeEval(g,ιMulti(v)). For additivity in slot i, take the length-(n+1) tuple formed by update(w,i,x) and the extra element y. Substitute the old basis vector plus the extra basis vector at i; multilinearity of ιMulti and linearity of wedgeEval give the sum of the two evaluations. For scalar compatibility substitute c times the basis vector in the tuple update(w,i,x). If w(i)=w(j), substitute the i-th basis vector in slot j; the tuple of ideal combinations is still w but its wedge is zero by alternation. These three verified identities construct the alternating map F₀ on I.

Every ev(w) is annihilated by I: a in I kills x tensor 1 by moving the scalar to the quotient factor. Monicity of iCycles implies that a kills its explicit cycle lift, and linearity passes this through homologyπ and the induced homology map. Restrict F₀ to torsionBySet to get F. The arbitrary-vector substitution formula gives the required equality for s; its canonical cycle lift equals s.z by wedgeCycles_spec, s.hz and monicity of iCycles. For n=0 the basis wedge is the empty wedge, and the same tensor argument handles its ideal annihilation. No step assumes I proper, a nonzero ring, regularity, or invertibility of two.

based_on.place: Koszul functoriality and uniqueness up to homotopy of augmentation lifts; direct exterior-power proof, avoiding Tate resolutions

lean.statement:
theorem koszul_ideal_alternating_products (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) (P : ProjectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))) :
    ∃ (b : ∀ (r : ℕ) (g : Fin r → I),
      ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A r (fun j ↦ (g j : A)) ⟶ P.complex)
      (F : I [⋀^Fin n]→ₗ[A]
        (Submodule.torsionBySet A
          ((((tensorRight (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj
            P.complex).homology n) (I : Set A))),
      (∀ (r : ℕ) (g : Fin r → I), (b r g).f 0 ≫ P.π.f 0 =
        ModuleCat.ofHom (I.mkQ.comp
          (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv A (Fin r →₀ A)).toLinearMap)) ∧
      (∀ s : KoszulConormalWedgeCycle A I n,
        (F (fun j ↦ Finsupp.linearCombination A s.g (s.v j))).val =
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) (.down ℕ) n).map
            (((tensorRight (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).map
              (b s.r s.g)))
            ((((tensorRight (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.down ℕ)).obj
              (ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A s.r
                (fun j ↦ (s.g j : A)))).homologyπ n s.z))
